data.long_meaning: The name Willdon is derived from Old English 'wild' meaning 'powerful' and 'don' meaning 'gift from God'. This name is often given to children born into families who value strength and devotion to their faith. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin.
